# e2b_team_metrics (Data Source)

Reads E2B team concurrency and sandbox-start-rate metrics. E2B exposes team metrics as read-only telemetry and does not expose metric creation through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_team_metrics" "current" {
  team_id = "team_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) E2B team ID.

### Optional

- `end` (Number) Optional Unix timestamp for the end of the interval, in seconds.
- `start` (Number) Optional Unix timestamp for the start of the interval, in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `metrics` (Attributes List) Metric points returned by E2B. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics`

Read-Only:

- `concurrent_sandboxes` (Number) Concurrent sandboxes for the team.
- `sandbox_start_rate` (Number) Sandboxes started per second.
- `timestamp` (String) Deprecated RFC3339 timestamp returned by E2B.
- `timestamp_unix` (Number) Unix timestamp for the metric point.
